derivedViews.label: Amplitude strength
derivedViews.basis: envelope-style magnitude derived from processed amplitude tiles
derivedViews.caveat: Experimental display aid; not an interpreted structure or target.

derivedViews.label: Edge / gradient emphasis
derivedViews.basis: local amplitude-gradient enhancement on source-derived tiles
derivedViews.caveat: Experimental continuity cue; not an automatic fault pick.

derivedViews.label: Coherence-like discontinuity
derivedViews.basis: neighborhood similarity proxy for discontinuity screening
derivedViews.caveat: Screening layer only; manual interpretation required before use.

derivedViews.label: Horizon-following slice
derivedViews.basis: manually reviewed horizon surface sampled against seismic volume
derivedViews.caveat: Requires reviewed horizon basis before being shown as interpretation.

interpretationLayers.label: Reviewed faults
interpretationLayers.caveat: No seismic reflector is auto-labeled as a fault or mineralized structure.

interpretationLayers.label: Reviewed horizons
interpretationLayers.geometry: section picks and optional horizon surfaces
interpretationLayers.caveat: Horizons must be manually reviewed before investor or regulatory display.

interpretationLayers.label: Target corridors
interpretationLayers.caveat: Target corridors are interpreted overlays and must not imply mineralization without review.

interpretationLayers.label: Presentation annotations
interpretationLayers.caveat: Annotations should distinguish measured, processed, and interpreted content.
